title: The Type-I Seesaw as a Relativistic Fermionic Proximity Effect: Spectral Moments, EFT Consistency, and Sterile-Sector Reconstruction
summary: We formulate the type-I seesaw as a relativistic fermionic proximity effect in the exact active-sector two-point kernel. Active neutrinos have no renormalizable gauge-invariant Majorana mass and couple by lepton-number-conserving Yukawa hybridization to a sterile Majorana pairing kernel. Integrating out the sterile fields gives a nonlocal Nambu-Gorkov embedding self-energy. In a sterile Takagi basis its anomalous and normal flavor responses are $\mathcal{A}(Q^2)=\sum_i M_i y_i y_i^T/(Q^2+M_i^2)$ and $\mathcal{B}(Q^2)=\sum_i y_i y_i^\dagger/(Q^2+M_i^2)$, respectively.
